subject: 5-Bullet Friday — The Series That Bends Reality, Easy Cooking Upgrades, Stephen King on Polite Society, and Strange but Sensible Housing

bullets.title: Undone
bullets.note: This amazing series bends time and reality enough to simulate a psychedelic experience. [Check out this short trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f8kW2LI19K4), and the preceding sentence will make more sense. Here’s a short description: “[_Undone_](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0875MWHHN/?tag=offsitoftimfe-20) is a half-hour, genre-bending, animated series that explores the elastic nature of reality through its central character Alma, a twenty-eight-year-old living in San Antonio, Texas. After getting into a car accident and nearly dying, Alma finds she has a new relationship to time. She develops this new ability in order to find out the truth about her father’s death.” _Undone_ was created by [Raphael Bob-Waksberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raphael_Bob-Waksberg) (_BoJack Horseman_) and [Kate Purdy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kate_Purdy) (also _BoJack Horseman_) and stars [Rosa Salazar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rosa_Salazar) (_Alita: Battle Angel_), among others. I’ve been recommending it to nearly all of my closest friends.

bullets.section: What I’m using in the kitchen
bullets.title: Momofuku Soy Sauce
bullets.note:
This was introduced to me by a James Beard Award-winning chef, who explained how it’s totally different from anything you’d typically buy at a grocery store in the US. It’s a naturally brewed soy sauce, meaning it’s produced using the traditional microbial fermentation process rather than chemical hydrolysis. I bought this at Whole Foods.  
​  
Momofuku is the brainchild of legendary chef [David Chang](https://www.instagram.com/davidchang/), who _Esquire_ called one of the most influential people of the twenty-first century. His team’s soy sauce is built on 10 years of flavor research from the Momofuku Goods team, and it’s steeped with [_kombu_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kombu) for 48 hours, which gives it a richer, rounder savory profile than anything you’ll find at the grocery store. It’s restaurant-grade and an easy way to elevate simple things like steamed vegetables or give an Asian twist to main dishes.

bullets.title: ‘We have brothers, sons, lovers – but they can’t live here!’ The happy home shared by 26 women
bullets.creator: Anita Chaudhuri
bullets.note: . “That this is an idea whose time has come, particularly for older people, is indisputable. In 2021, 3.64 million people aged over 65 were living alone in the UK, 70% of whom were women. In 10 years’ time, over-65s will have risen from 19% to an estimated 22% of the population, according to the latest report by the Centre for Ageing Better.”

bullets.title: “If you expect to succeed as a writer, rudeness should be the second-to-least of your concerns. The least of all should be polite society and what it expects.
